name: Toujouin Kyouka
source:
Affiliation: Hazuki Private School 1st year, Group A (Formerly: Minazuki Government Academy) / Former student council president
Favorite food: Mineral water
Gift: Impossible Gate (The ability to teleport to a place with 10 meter distance, but it has to be a straight line)

[url=/c10098]Himeno's[/url] right hand. Kyoka is extremely loyal to Himeno, always serious and behaves like a soldier. Unlike [url=/c10118]Patricia's[/url] Light Saber, Kyoka carries an umbrella (which is actually a katana) everywhere she goes. If she uses Impossible Gate in front of you, you're pretty much guaranteed to die.

[From [url=http://visualnovelspam.blogspot.fi/2013/08/hyperhighspeedgenius-thoughts.html]Visual Novel Spam[/url]]
